caption:
StackAdapt just rolled out cross-channel retargeting for ChatGPT ads. So now, even when you are asking a robot for life advice, you cannot escape that one jacket you left in your cart. Ads really are finding every single place we hide.

Have you ever actually bought something an ad chased you across the internet with?

post.news: StackAdapt added cross-channel retargeting for ChatGPT ads.
